test_cases.expected: Markdown ranking table with 排名/标题/热度/来源 and up to 10 rows

test_cases.name: Plain-text output
test_cases.expected: Plain-text ranked list, at most 5 entries

test_cases.expected: Parseable JSON object whose items array has at most 3 entries

notes: Public keyless hot-list API, read-only; no Huawei Cloud credentials, CLI, SDK or AK/SK are needed. The smoke harness only executes hcloud/curl commands, so these script cases are reported as not-executed; the structural self-check plus the offline unit tests under tests/ (HTTP mocked) cover the behaviour.
